description: Header file defining structures, macros, and function prototypes for DMA driver implementation specific to STM32 microcontrollers within the Zephyr RTOS project.

classes.name: dma_stm32_stream
classes.description: Represents a DMA stream configuration and state for STM32 devices.

classes.name: dma_stm32_data
classes.description: Holds DMA context data for STM32 DMA driver.

classes.name: dma_stm32_config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for STM32 DMA driver including clock, IRQ, and stream info.

methods.name: dma_stm32_id_to_stream
methods.description: Converts a DMA ID to a stream index.

methods.name: dma_stm32_slot_to_channel
methods.description: Converts a DMA ID to a channel number (if not using DMAMUX).

methods.name: dma_stm32_is_tc_active
methods.description: Checks if transfer complete (TC) is active for a given DMA stream.

methods.name: dma_stm32_clear_tc
methods.description: Clears the transfer complete flag for a DMA stream.

methods.name: dma_stm32_is_ht_active
methods.description: Checks if half transfer (HT) is active for a DMA stream.

methods.name: dma_stm32_clear_ht
methods.description: Clears the half transfer flag for a DMA stream.

methods.name: dma_stm32_is_te_active
methods.description: Checks if transfer error (TE) is active for a DMA stream.

methods.name: dma_stm32_clear_te
methods.description: Clears the transfer error flag for a DMA stream.

methods.name: dma_stm32_is_dme_active
methods.description: Checks if direct mode error (DME) is active (V1).

methods.name: dma_stm32_clear_dme
methods.description: Clears the direct mode error flag (V1).

methods.name: dma_stm32_is_fe_active
methods.description: Checks if FIFO error (FE) is active (V1).

methods.name: dma_stm32_clear_fe
methods.description: Clears the FIFO error flag (V1).

methods.name: dma_stm32_is_gi_active
methods.description: Checks if global interrupt (GI) is active (V2).

methods.name: dma_stm32_clear_gi
methods.description: Clears the global interrupt flag (V2).

methods.name: stm32_dma_is_irq_active
methods.description: Checks if DMA IRQ is active.

methods.name: stm32_dma_is_ht_irq_active
methods.description: Checks if half transfer IRQ is active.

methods.name: stm32_dma_is_tc_irq_active
methods.description: Checks if transfer complete IRQ is active.

methods.name: stm32_dma_dump_stream_irq
methods.description: Dumps IRQ status for a DMA stream.

methods.name: stm32_dma_clear_stream_irq
methods.description: Clears IRQ flags for a DMA stream.

methods.name: stm32_dma_is_irq_happened
methods.description: Checks if an IRQ has occurred.

methods.name: stm32_dma_is_unexpected_irq_happened
methods.description: Checks if an unexpected IRQ has occurred.

methods.name: stm32_dma_enable_stream
methods.description: Enables a DMA stream.

methods.name: stm32_dma_is_enabled_stream
methods.description: Checks if a DMA stream is enabled.

methods.name: stm32_dma_disable_stream
methods.description: Disables a DMA stream.

methods.name: dma_stm32_configure
methods.description: Configures a DMA stream.

methods.name: dma_stm32_reload
methods.description: Reloads DMA stream parameters.

methods.name: dma_stm32_start
methods.description: Starts DMA transfer on a stream.

methods.name: dma_stm32_stop
methods.description: Stops DMA transfer on a stream.

methods.name: dma_stm32_get_status
methods.description: Retrieves status of a DMA stream.
